title: storage-io-measurement
summary: Measure storage I/O for LLM/diffusion serving without conflating device metrics with application outcomes: match the fio workload to the observed loader signature, validate requested-versus-achieved I/O depth, keep a cache-state ledger (warm/cold/unknown with method), classify startup vs steady-state runs, read outputs with unit and latency-provenance awareness, attribute traffic per device (iostat) and per process (pidstat), and gate any "storage bottleneck" claim through a saturation-evidence check plus a separate application-outcome layer. Measurement methodology only — running benchmarks or manipulating caches requires separate authorization.

applicability.scope: Measure and attribute storage traffic for model loading or serving while separating device/process observations from application outcomes and cache/startup effects.
applicability.prerequisites: Resolve backing devices and participating worker PIDs first; active fio benchmarks or cache manipulation require separate authorization, with bounded observation during already-authorized runs.
applicability.input_contract: Observed loader access pattern, tool/OS/filesystem versions, file-to-device mapping, worker PIDs, phase timestamps, cache-state method and raw IO/job/application measurements.
applicability.produced_artifact: A workload- and cache-qualified IO evidence record with units, achieved depth, errors/bytes/completion and device/process attribution, plus a separately measured application outcome where benefit is claimed.
applicability.refusal_point: Reject unspecified or copied-example benchmark workloads; do not name a storage bottleneck from util/iowait alone or infer application gain from synthetic bandwidth.

recommendations: Match the fio read pattern to the observed loader and verify achieved rather than requested depth; more queued work can increase latency.
Record warm/cold/unknown cache state and its method, separate startup from repeated/steady reads, and check completed bytes for truncated runs.
Align per-device and per-process observations with the application phase, retain units and latency provenance, and corroborate saturation using traffic, queues and process activity.
Only run a separately authorized bounded read-only job against an explicit existing regular file, then remeasure the real application before accepting a benefit.
